Sandbox_SCKCO_RepairEnabled_tooltip: Allow welding damaged armor plates back into condition.
Sandbox_SCKCO_BodyRepairEnabled_tooltip: Extend the armor welding system to vanilla doors, hood, and trunk.
Sandbox_SCKCO_ReplaceVanillaRepair_toolt: Remove vanilla's Repair option on body panels, so welding fully replaces it. Off = both options coexist. Only affects body panels; armor, tires and seats have no vanilla repair to remove.
Sandbox_SCKCO_RepairHideUnusable_tooltip: On the world right-click menu, hide a repair group entirely when nothing in it can currently be repaired. The mechanics panel still shows the option with its reason.
Sandbox_SCKCO_SeatRepairEnabled_tooltip: Extend the repair system to seat upholstery using needle, thread and strips. Always gated on Tailoring.
Sandbox_SCKCO_RepairMaterialScale_toolti: Scales every per-pass material cost: torch fuel, welding rods, tire patches, thread and tape. 0 makes repairs free.
Sandbox_SCKCO_RestrictToSCVehicles_toolt: Only offer repair and scrapping on vehicles whose script name starts with SC_. Off = the system also applies to vanilla and other mods' vehicles.
Sandbox_SCKCO_RepairLooseParts_tooltip: Offer the same repair on parts sitting in inventory, using identical tools, skill and material costs. Scrapping stays vehicle-only; loose parts have disassembly recipes.
Sandbox_SCKCO_ScrapEnabled_tooltip: Allow stripping a destroyed part off the vehicle for materials. The part is removed and cannot be recovered.
Sandbox_SCKCO_ScrapYieldScale_tooltip: Scales the materials a part could yield before losses are rolled. 0 recovers nothing.
Sandbox_SCKCO_ScrapLossBase_tooltip: Percent chance each individual unit of material comes out ruined at skill 0. Rolled per unit, so yields vary.
Sandbox_SCKCO_ScrapLossPerSkill_tooltip: Loss percent removed per level of the governing skill.
Sandbox_SCKCO_ScrapUseRecipes_tooltip: Look up the craft recipe that builds a part and recover its inputs. Falls back to the built-in table when no recipe is found.
Sandbox_SCKCO_SeatAllowTape_tooltip: Let duct tape stand in for needle, thread and strips when restitching seats. Faster to source, but far more likely to fail.
Sandbox_SCKCO_SeatTapeFailPenalty_toolti: Added fail percent when patching a seat with tape instead of a full needle-and-thread kit.
Sandbox_SCKCO_TireRepairEnabled_tooltip: Extend the repair system to tires, using a patch kit or rubber cement. Always gated on Mechanics.
Sandbox_SCKCO_TireFlatThreshold_tooltip: Tire pressure below this fraction of capacity counts as flat. A flat tire must be pumped before it can be patched.
Sandbox_SCKCO_RepairSkillMode_tooltip: Which skill governs repair: Mechanics, Metalworking, or the higher of both.
Sandbox_SCKCO_RepairMinSkill_tooltip: Governing skill required before repair can be attempted.
Sandbox_SCKCO_RepairCloseFraction_toolti: Fraction of a plate's missing condition closed by a single pass at skill 0.
Sandbox_SCKCO_RepairCloseFractionPerSkil: Added to the close fraction per governing skill level. Reaches full-close at high skill.
Sandbox_SCKCO_RepairDegradePerPass_toolt: Maximum condition a plate permanently loses per successful pass. Drives it toward scrap.
Sandbox_SCKCO_RepairScrapCeiling_tooltip: Once a plate's max condition decays to this, it is scrap and can no longer be repaired.
Sandbox_SCKCO_RepairTotalLossThreshold_t: A part at or below this condition is destroyed and unrepairable. 0 = only fully-destroyed parts; raise to make near-dead parts unrecoverable too.
Sandbox_SCKCO_RepairMinGap_tooltip: Repair is unavailable unless a part is at least this many condition points below its ceiling. Prevents wasteful passes on effectively-full parts.
Sandbox_SCKCO_MetalRequireMask_tooltip: Require a welding mask in inventory alongside torch and rods.
Sandbox_SCKCO_RepairBaseTime_tooltip: Pass duration in ticks before damage/skill scaling.
Sandbox_SCKCO_RepairTimePerDamage_toolti: Ticks added per point of missing condition.
Sandbox_SCKCO_RepairTimePerSkillLevel_to: Ticks subtracted per governing skill level.
Sandbox_SCKCO_RepairFailBase_tooltip: Base percent chance a pass fails at skill 0 on an undamaged plate.
Sandbox_SCKCO_RepairFailPerDamage_toolti: Added fail percent per point of missing condition.
Sandbox_SCKCO_RepairFailPerSkill_tooltip: Fail percent removed per governing skill level.
Sandbox_SCKCO_RepairFailMax_tooltip: Hard cap on fail chance regardless of damage.
Sandbox_SCKCO_RepairBotchChance_tooltip: Percent chance a failed pass also damages the affected part (parent for armor, self for body).
Sandbox_SCKCO_RepairBotchDamage_tooltip: Condition removed on a botched pass.
Sandbox_SCKCO_RepairXPPerDamage_tooltip: Extra experience per point of condition restored.
